caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of nine square blocks arranged in a three-by-three grid, each displaying a distinct geometric or floral pattern. The quilt blocks are bordered with a multicolored strip composed of beige, brown, blue, and some pastel-patterned shapes. The quilt squares feature the following: The top row has a red geometric pattern made of rectangles and squares on the left, a yellow sunburst or sunflower-like pattern in the center, and a red symmetrical appliqué design resembling leaves or abstract shapes on the right. The middle row shows a blue and brown geometric “X” or windmill pattern on the left, a central block with a depiction of a person in elaborate clothing with a parasol, flanked by a small animal and items, and a colorful, eight-point star pattern using fabrics of blue, red, beige, and floral prints on the right. The bottom row contains a circular red pattern with interior motifs and small accents around the circle on the left, a blue and pink eight-pointed star with a darker blue circular center in the middle, and a pattern on the right of four red leaf-like or petal shapes radiating from a central point, with additional small round red shapes. All the patterns are set on a beige or off-white background. The overall composition creates a patchwork effect, mimicking a traditional quilt.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
